entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-22
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [Suggestion] Emit `[DoesNotReturn]` on generated `ThrowSwitchExpressionException` for switch expressions Roslyn does not consider exhaustive #81412
  • "Failed to get language for textDocument/diagnostic" when saving a new file #81410

Closed

  • Add ServiceHub tests that validates that the remote process is initialized correctly based on servicehub.service.json #18993
  • Add `Type` in `IRangeVariableSymbol` #81379
    18.3
  • Assertion when trying to rename a type to "extension" via refactoring #81402

PullRequests

Created

  • Improve 'else' indentation in a couple more cases #81411
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #81409
    Area-Compilers, VSCode

Updated

  • Reduce cascading errors when record inherits from non-record #81293
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Improve error message for misplaced variable designator in property patterns #81287
    Area-Compilers
  • Improve diagnostic for != operator in patterns #81294
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
